  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Categorical DSEM roadmap}

---

Binary and ordinal DSEM will use an explicit latent-response probit model. Its
threshold identification, residual scale, centering, lag interpretation, and
data augmentation must be verified before estimation is enabled.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", family = "binary", time = "time")
dsem(model, data) # capability error in the current release
```

See the categorical DSEM source in `research/manifest.csv` for the primary
interpretation and parity reference.
